display.purpose: One factual promise in the first viewport.

code.purpose: Commands, identifiers, paths, routes, and measured values only.

motion.name: native-scroll
motion.purpose: Wayfinding between chapters; no decorative entrance motion.

rules: Color marks action or real state, never decoration.
Use code, evidence, rules, and diagrams as the visual material.
Operational hierarchy comes from alignment before container chrome.
dos: Show product mechanics with realistic, labeled synthetic evidence.
Preserve generous reading intervals around dense operational passages.
donts: Do not construct pages from repeated icon cards.
Do not use gradients, glass, glow, or decorative metric charts.
